paper.title_en: Emission of pairs of neutrinos by a variable field in the second Born approximation. Effective Lagrangian of the photon-neutrino interaction
paper.abstract_en: We consider the generation of a pair of neutrinos by a variable classical electromagnetic field in the second Born approximation, which is analogous to the nonlinear effect of photon emission under the same conditions. This effect is of interest for extending the nonlinear processes of quantum electrodynamics to other particles with zero or vanishingly small masses, such as neutrinos. We find a class of fields for which this effect does not exist, in contrast to the quantum electrodynamics effects discussed in previous papers written with the participation of the author. The effective Lagrangian of the photon-neutrino interaction is obtained for the first time.
